svg.text: Complete cables are represented by one logical connector. Use sheets 02 and 03 for individual conductors.

g.text: 5 V controls per owner; verify taps
Not connected to Pi or Due
Pi powers the Due through Native USB. FPGA has its own supply.
LEDs use a regulated 5 V supply; never use JA power pins for LEDs.
Join low-voltage grounds; never join independent 3.3 V / 5 V outputs.
The bitstream must implement NES input, PS/2 mouse, LEDs and audio.
The Pi needs a compatible ARM JTAG loader and board/cable support.
